description: §42.2.3 — the control for condition/given-head-bool-refused-*: identifier-list heads (`given a :>`, `given a, b =>`) are accepted — no E-SYNTAX-044, no error at all. Each guard surfaces the S462 soft-deprecation W-GIVEN-PRESENCE-DEPRECATED (2).
rationale: §42.2.3: `given-guard ::= 'given' identifier-list (':>' | '=>') block` — an identifier-list head is well-formed; the in-place guard is soft-deprecated (S462 "a, go") and surfaces W-GIVEN-PRESENCE-DEPRECATED. Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a".
